hero.title: BBS in Mauritius
hero.subtitle: A Bachelor of Business Studies (BBS) is an undergraduate degree that covers business principles, management, accounting, finance, marketing, economics and organizational operations. It can be suitable for students wishing to prepare themselves for careers in business, administration, financial services, entrepreneurship or for further education in management. **BBS in Mauritius** is a study option for students interested in undergraduate business education and developing a foundation in business-related subjects.

overview: Students in Mauritius need to know the difference between a degree called Bachelor of Business Studies (BBS) and other degrees such as Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA), Bachelor of Business Management or BSc (Hons) Business Management. The University of Mauritius lists business management degrees for 2026-2027, and Honoris Educational Network advertizes a BBA delivered through supported distance learning. Students searching for a **Bachelor of Business Studies in Mauritius** should confirm the exact qualification title and awarding institution before applying.

faq.question: Do they have a BBS (Bachelor of Business Studies) in Mauritius?
faq.answer: The institutions mentioned here offer related programs such as BSc (Hons) Business Management, BBM (Hons) and BBA. Before you apply, check with the institution about any specific BBS award. Students searching for a Bachelor of Business Studies in Mauritius should verify whether the exact qualification is available.

faq.question: How long does it take to study a business degree in Mauritius?
faq.answer: Full-time, many undergraduate business degrees take around three years. The BSc (Hons) Business Management at the Open University of Mauritius has a flexible duration of three to six years.

faq.question: What is the tuition fee of BBS in Mauritius?
faq.answer: No confirmed fee for any particular BBS program was found in the sources consulted. Conversely, the Open University of Mauritius charges \$6,840 for its full BSc (Hons) Business Management for international non-SADC students.

faq.question: Is it possible for Indian students to do a business degree in Mauritius after Class 12?
faq.answer: Yes, Indian students can apply for it if they meet the academic and other entry requirements of the chosen institution. They need to explore how their Class 12 qualification is evaluated, the applicable international tuition fees and the study-permit procedures that are currently in place.

faq.question: What to do after BBS?
faq.answer: Graduates may wish to pursue an MBA, MSc Management, MSc International Business Management or specialist master’s in finance, marketing or human resources. Admission will be subject to qualification obtained and entry requirements of the postgraduate program.
